# Tanahku

> Free web application for measuring land area accurately using satellite imagery. Mark boundaries, calculate geodesic area/perimeter, and export results as PDF or GeoJSON. Bilingual EN/ID. No registration required.

## About

- **Name**: Tanahku
- **URL**: https://tanahku.vercel.app
- **Languages**: Bahasa Indonesia, English
- **Category**: Geospatial / Land Survey / Productivity
- **Pricing**: Free, no registration, no ads
- **Technology**: React 18, Vite 6, Leaflet, Turf.js, Tailwind CSS
- **Repository**: https://github.com/leoui/tanahku

## Features

- Draw polygon boundaries by clicking on a satellite map
- Real-time geodesic area calculation (m², hectares, Indonesian tumbak)
- Perimeter, bounding-box dimensions, center coordinates
- Self-intersection detection with visual warning
- Reverse geocoding via OpenStreetMap (address, village, district, city, province)
- Accuracy confidence indicator (High/Medium/Low)
- Export to PDF report (with map screenshot, measurements table, QR code)
- Export to GeoJSON for GIS import
- Share via native Web Share API, WhatsApp, Telegram, or clipboard
- Multiple tile layers: Esri Satellite, Google Satellite, OpenStreetMap, Hybrid
- GPS geolocation with high-accuracy mode
- Worldwide location search via Nominatim
- Full bilingual UI with persistent language toggle
- Dark glassmorphism UI with responsive design
- Error boundary with graceful crash recovery

## How It Works

1. Search for a location globally using the search bar
2. Click "Mark Land" to enter drawing mode
3. Click on the satellite map to place boundary vertices
4. Drag vertices to adjust; use Undo to remove points
5. Click "Done" to finalize the polygon
6. View measurements in the right panel
7. Share results or export to PDF / GeoJSON

## Technical

- Geodesic calculations use Turf.js (Vincenty formulae) for Earth-curvature-aware accuracy
- jsPDF and html2canvas are lazy-loaded (dynamic import) to minimize initial bundle size
- All API calls use AbortController for cancellation and stale-state prevention
- Indonesian tumbak units adjust per province (Jawa Barat: 14 m², Bali: 10 m², Lombok: 12 m²)
- Language preference persisted in localStorage
- 0 npm audit vulnerabilities; jsPDF upgraded from 2.x to 4.x to patch 12 CVEs

## API Dependencies

- OpenStreetMap Nominatim (geocoding, rate-limited per OSM policy)
- Esri World Imagery / Google Maps tiles (satellite imagery)
- QR Server API (qrserver.com, QR code generation)
